description: Retrieve all-time statistics for a district by abbreviation. Returns district_data (active team counts, event counts, and teams gained and lost per year, district-wide and per region) and team_data keyed by team key (district seasons, total district points, event and DCMP wins, blue banners, awards, qualification and playoff records, DCMP and Championship appearances). Very large for big districts (about 600 KB for 'fim', 65 KB for 'isr'); for one season's standings prefer get_district_rankings, and for season leaderboards get_insights_for_district_by_category.

district_abbreviation.description: FRC district abbreviation without a year (e.g., 'fim' for FIRST in Michigan, 'ne' for New England, 'chs' for Chesapeake, 'pnw' for Pacific Northwest, 'fit' for FIRST In Texas). Covers every season of the district, including renames such as 'mar' to 'fma'. Use get_districts to discover abbreviations.
